{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_orientation_change", "thread_id": "th_orient_change", "from_": "vp-people@company.example.com", "to": ["hr-ops@company.example.com"], "subject": "Orientation Duration Change for Remote Employees", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2026-03-18T10:00:00Z"}

日期：2026-03-18T10:00:00Z
主题：Orientation Duration Change for Remote Employees
Team,

Effective immediately, orientation sessions for remote employees should be 2 hours instead of 1 hour to include the additional remote work policy and VPN setup walkthrough. In-office employees keep the standard 1-hour session.

- VP People"}

Team,

- HR Director"}
